import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    P = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    Q = [int(x) for x in data[1+n:1+2*n]]
    # pos[b] = person index (1-based) wearing bib b
    pos = [0] * (n + 1)
    for j in range(n):
        pos[Q[j]] = j + 1
    # Q indexed by person (1-based): Q[p-1]
    res = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        j = pos[i]
        target = P[j - 1]
        res.append(Q[target - 1])
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, res)) + "\n")

from hypothesis import strategies as st

@st.composite
def gen(draw):
    n = draw(st.integers(2, 7))
    p = draw(st.permutations(list(range(1, n + 1))))
    q = draw(st.permutations(list(range(1, n + 1))))
    return f"{n}\n{' '.join(map(str, p))}\n{' '.join(map(str, q))}\n"

def validate(inp):
    t = inp.split()
    if len(t) < 1:
        return False
    n = int(t[0])
    if not (2 <= n <= 3 * 10**5):
        return False
    if len(t) != 1 + 2 * n:
        return False
    p = [int(x) for x in t[1:1 + n]]
    q = [int(x) for x in t[1 + n:1 + 2 * n]]
    if sorted(p) != list(range(1, n + 1)):
        return False
    if sorted(q) != list(range(1, n + 1)):
        return False
    return True

def ref(inp):
    t = inp.split()
    n = int(t[0])
    P = [int(x) for x in t[1:1 + n]]
    Q = [int(x) for x in t[1 + n:1 + 2 * n]]
    # 1-indexed helpers
    # person j wears bib Q[j-1] and stares at person P[j-1]
    # bib-number i is worn by the person j with Q[j-1] == i
    # that person stares at person P[j-1], who wears bib Q[P[j-1]-1]
    res = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        person = None
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            if Q[j - 1] == i:
                person = j
                break
        target_person = P[person - 1]
        bib = Q[target_person - 1]
        res.append(bib)
    return " ".join(map(str, res))

def validate(inp):
    lines = inp.strip().split("\n")
    if len(lines) != 3:
        return False
    n = int(lines[0].strip())
    p = [int(x) for x in lines[1].split()]
    q = [int(x) for x in lines[2].split()]
    if not (2 <= n <= 3 * 10**5):
        return False
    if len(p) != n or len(q) != n:
        return False
    if sorted(p) != list(range(1, n + 1)):
        return False
    if sorted(q) != list(range(1, n + 1)):
        return False
    return True

def ref(inp):
    lines = inp.strip().split("\n")
    n = int(lines[0].strip())
    P = [int(x) for x in lines[1].split()]
    Q = [int(x) for x in lines[2].split()]
    # Person index j (1-based) wears bib Q[j-1]; they stare at person P[j-1].
    # Bib number i belongs to the person j with Q[j-1] == i.
    res = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        # find person j wearing bib i
        j = None
        for k in range(n):
            if Q[k] == i:
                j = k
                break
        target_person = P[j]  # person number staring at
        # bib number of that person
        ans = Q[target_person - 1]
        res.append(ans)
    return " ".join(map(str, res))
